item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 25/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The easterly airstream is expected to be replaced by a southerly airstream on Wednesday. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will move southwards and edge closer to the coast of southern China gradually. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region later on Wednesday and on Thursday. The trough of low pressure will linger over the vicinity of the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week. There will be a few showers over the region.
